_README: UK companies named in the BPH profiles, for the formation-agent measurement.
DATA, not code. Add entries here; the collector needs no changes.
Seeded 22 Aug 2026 from company numbers appearing in bphs/*.html. Numbers are
far better than names: Companies House name search is fuzzy and there are many
THE QUESTION THIS ASKS is not who these companies are. It is whether they
SHARE anything: a registered office, a director, a company secretary, an
incorporation date pattern. A formation agent that stands behind several of
them is reachable by policy in a way the operators are not, and nobody counts
them. If they share nothing, that is a real answer too, and the same answer
the registry sponsors collector already gave about LIRs.
UK ONLY. Estonia, Russia, Germany, Israel and US-state registries are separate
systems. A provider absent here is not clean, it is elsewhere.
search_only entries have no number yet and will be looked up by name; treat
any match as a candidate rather than a confirmation.
